question: Which alveolar identity markers differ in expression among the sorted residual AMs?
decision: Assess phenotype among remaining cells separately from flow abundance and donor recovery.
strongest_rival: Selection of recovered cells or differing preparation composition contributes to aggregate RNA differences.
discriminator: Check all deposited libraries, author directions and the prespecified markers. A bulk difference cannot locate a cell trajectory.
exposure_record: Published main text, figure captions and workbook headers were read before freeze. Local numerical outcomes were not calculated.
biological_unit: The deposited library is the description unit; donor preparation and recipient or pool crosswalks are unresolved.
nesting_and_overlap: Do not pair replicate labels. Tables and deposits share their original source and do not constitute independent replication.
population_and_selection: Public per-library quantifications and author tables. The transfer and AM assays describe selected recovered cells.
contrast: Mean WT minus mean KO log2(TPM+1) within sorted LysM alveolar macrophages.
endpoint: Transcript-derived gene TPM; published DESeq2 fold changes; combined genomic peak overlaps where applicable.
methods: Calculate per-transcript TPM from estimated counts divided by effective length; sum by Ensembl release 90 transcript stable ID to gene symbol, stripping version. Report equal-library mean log2(TPM+1) contrasts. Outer-join nonduplicate author symbols. Use release 113 GRCm39 gene body plus/minus 2 kb around TSS for combined BED annotation if applicable.
missingness_and_exclusions: Drop ambiguous duplicate author symbols and retain unmatched rows; exclude unmapped transcript symbols while reporting matched targets and TPM. Retain all deposited libraries and report planned omission of the third day-7 WT library separately.
multiplicity: Descriptive comparisons only, no new P values. Retain author adjusted P values and apply planned signature thresholds.
precision_basis: Observed library values and omission sensitivity are descriptive; unresolved source nesting prevents a precision claim.
interpretation_limit: No causal pathway, lineage or cell-level inference. Peak overlap is limited to the chosen feature; no antibody-pair effect estimate.
stop_rule: Hold model-based inference if biological unit mapping is unresolved; require all declared libraries and valid checksums.
amendment_reason: Initial descriptive reconstruction on public processed and author-reported inputs.
